name: Kev Carmody Residential Scholarship (UQ)
summary: Covers a standard room at Kev Carmody House for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander UQ students facing financial hardship.
key: Cost of residency in a standard room at Kev Carmody House, for 1 year.
who: Domestic student enrolled full-time in an approved program.
Can demonstrate financial hardship with documents.
Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person.
how: Apply using the online form with your QTAC or UQ student number, evidence of financial hardship and proof of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander status.
catches: The main round closed 9 October 2026. The second round runs 10 October to 4 December 2026.
